description: Fighter types. radius: collision circle (m); walkSpeed: marching pace (m/s), a squad marches at its slowest member's; runSpeed: top speed (m/s), for now only to catch up with the formation slot; turnRate: how fast a fighter turns (degrees/s). Optional kit (M3): weapon, shield, bodyArmour, headCover, experience, type — ids from combat.json; what a type leaves out comes from its defaultKit (sword, round shield, padded coat, cap, experienced, default). warrior: the default kit; spearman: spear, spearman type; levy: axe, shield only, new; veteran: mail and helm, elite. Speeds agreed 2026-11-20; radius and turnRate are placeholders, tuned on the M1 bench.
